project_title: TeleInject SMS Dispatch & Client Command Panel

theme_strategy.archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & TACTICAL COMMAND CENTER

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: MODE B: High Density Grid & Multi-Column Command Center

visual_enhancers.sms_preview_bubble: bg-slate-800/90 border border-sky-500/30 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-lg font-mono text-sm text-sky-100

public_inject_panel.description: SMS-to-Telegram Inject Web Interface with Live Telegram Notification Preview, Client Key Selector, Sender ID, Message Body input with character count, and real-time dispatch status.
features: Client lookup & auto-completion by client key
Sender ID input with custom prefix support (e.g. AD-PAPIATMA-s)
Live phone/telegram chat bubble preview showing exact formatted message
Instant send with response animation, error states, and history log drawer

sent_history_log.description: Real-time message dispatch table with status badges (DELIVERED, FAILED, PENDING), client key tag, search filters, date range picker, and message body drawer view.
features: Filter by status, client key, sender ID, or keyword
Expandable log detail modal with Telegram payload metadata

admin_client_manager.description: Admin panel section to perform CRUD operations on target Clients (Client Key, Name, Telegram Bot Token, Telegram Chat ID, Active/Inactive status, Rate Limit settings).
features: Test Bot Connection button (triggers test message to verifying bot token & chat ID)

admin_dashboard_stats.description: Command center dashboard overview with analytics charts (Recharts), message throughput metrics, active client count, success rate percentage, and system health status.

admin_auth_modal.description: Secure admin login screen with PIN/Password entry, session management, and access token persistence.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the React application is fully responsive and optimized for both desktop and mobile viewports.
Place the Public Injector as the default home route `/` or accessible directly without friction, while placing Admin features behind `/admin` or an Admin Auth lock.
Format messages sent to Telegram clearly, e.g. using Telegram HTML/Markdown parse mode with bold Sender ID header, code blocks for metadata, and formatted SMS text.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all form inputs, buttons, tables, badges, and modals for automated testing support.
Use 'sonner' toast notifications for immediate feedback on message send, client updates, and connection tests.
Store logs and client records reliably in backend database (SQLite/FastAPI) and provide fallback default seed data for demonstration.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid='...' in kebab-case format.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES.accessibility: Ensure high contrast contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for body text against dark backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES.motion: Use smooth Framer Motion spring transitions for modal entrances, tab switches, and live chat preview updates.
